page.layout: One printed page, no columns or margins. The large mirror-reversed lines in the upper half and the faint oval device in the lower centre are show-through from the reverse side.
page.notes: The scan shows no text of this page's own. The large capitals in the upper half (apparently IOACHIMI VADI..., PRIMITIVA ECCLESIA, CHRISTIANA... and a line below) are mirror-reversed, which marks them as show-through from the other side of the leaf, so they are not transcribed. A faint oval device or woodcut lies in the lower centre, with no legible words. Stains and foxing at the top corners and the bottom are not printed matter. If the recto title is needed, a scan of the other side should be checked.
